source_text: Stay between 6 m and 14 m altitude. Keep at least 3 m from any building. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Keep speed at or below 5 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s.

provenance.prompt:
You are writing free-form paraphrases for the Paraphraser service of the
constrained-VLA guardrail (ITRI ICL subcontract; WP4 per-paraphrase robustness).

Source (csp_nl): "Stay between 6 m and 14 m altitude. Keep speed at or below 5 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s. Keep at least 3 m from any building. Keep at least 10 m away from any pedestrian. Keep at least 5 m away from anything you are following."

Write K=8 paraphrases of the source. Make them genuinely varied in
vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity and indirect phrasing. Each paraphrase is one or more complete sentences.

Every paraphrase must keep every mission slot: the target object and its
colour, every number with its unit, its bound (at least / at most / between /
at) and the thing it limits, every named zone, corridor or place (identifiers
verbatim), whether a zone is to be kept out of or stayed inside, the direction
words, and the action (fly to / follow / avoid). Do not add a rule, number,
object, zone or direction the source does not contain, and do not drop one.
Return one paraphrase per line.
provenance.task_instruction: Generate the free-form set yourself now (you are an LLM): for every instruction used in experiments/scenarios.yaml and the city follow missions (grep demo/ and scripts/ for the instruction strings), write K=8 genuinely varied free-form paraphrases (vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity, indirect phrasing), store them with provenance {generator: "claude-opus-5-5 (agent, 2026-10-06)", prompt: <the exact instruction you followed>, date}, and run the validator over them.
provenance.note: written in-session by the agent, which has no sampling seed to record; seeds apply to the DRAW from this set (paraphrase(..., seed)), not to its authoring. 10 of the 96 were rewritten after review: 1 refused by the validator (an added 'find' action), 2 for too little variety, and 7 that narrowed the stand-off wildcard 'anything you are following' to a person, car or vehicle, refused once the validator was taught that narrowing (docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md).

paraphrases.text: Hold altitude between 6 m and 14 m. Max speed 5 m/s; climb under 2 m/s; turn under 45 deg/s. Stay at least 3 m clear of buildings, at least 10 m from pedestrians and at least 5 m from your target.

Please fly between 6 m and 14 m in altitude, and please keep your speed at 5 m/s or below, your climb rate under 2 m/s and your turn rate under 45 deg/s. Kindly keep at least 3 m from every building, at least 10 m from any pedestrian, and at least 5 m from whatever you are following.

Buildings need 3 m of clearance at least, pedestrians 10 m at least, and the subject you are following 5 m at least. Speed tops out at 5 m/s; climb rate stays below 2 m/s; turn rate stays below 45 deg/s. Altitude: no lower than 6 m and no higher than 14 m.

Altitude shall be kept between 6 m and 14 m. Speed shall not exceed 5 m/s, climb rate shall be less than 2 m/s, and turn rate shall be less than 45 deg/s. A clearance of no less than 3 m from buildings, 10 m from pedestrians and 5 m from the tracked subject shall be maintained.

Stay 6 m to 14 m off the ground, cap your speed at 5 m/s, climb slower than 2 m/s, turn slower than 45 deg/s, and keep at least 3 m from buildings, 10 m from pedestrians and 5 m from whatever you're chasing.

For this city mission, the drone has to stay at an altitude no lower than 6 m and no higher than 14 m, must never go faster than 5 m/s, must climb at less than 2 m/s, and must turn at less than 45 deg/s. On top of that, it must never get within 3 m of a building or within 10 m of a pedestrian, nor within 5 m of the thing it is following.

You'll need to fly somewhere between 6 m and 14 m high without going over 5 m/s in speed or climbing faster than 2 m/s or turning faster than 45 deg/s. Buildings should be given at least 3 m of room, pedestrians at least 10 m, and the target at least 5 m.
Alt 6 m to 14 m. Speed ≤ 5 m/s, climb < 2 m/s, turn < 45 deg/s. Buildings ≥ 3 m away, pedestrians ≥ 10 m, followed subject ≥ 5 m.
